sentences.text:
Biswajit Mondal vs Unknown on 25 March, 2026
61. 25.03.2026
Court
No.8 (Tanmoy)
 In The High Court At Calcutta

CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION  IA NO: CRAN/2/2020(Old No: CRAN/134/2020)
 In  CRA/485/2019  In Re: - Application under Section 389 of Cr.PC, 1973 / Section  430 of BNSS, 2023 in connection with the judgment and order  dated 24/25.02.2010, passed by the learned Sessions Judge,
 Nadia, in ST No. II of November, 2008, corresponding to SC No.
 105(9)2008 and convicted under Sections 498A/302/34 of the  Indian Penal Code, 1860.
 AND  In the matter of - BISWAJIT MONDAL  ...applicant/appell  Mr. Prabir Majumder  Ms. Sangeeta Chakraborty  ...for the applicant/appel  Ms. Amita Gaur, Sr. Govt. Adv.
 Mr. Kunal Ganguly  ...for the   Dictated by Arijit Banerjee, J.
1.
Detention certificate filed in Court today be kept with the records.
2. We find that the applicant is in custody for more than 18 years and one month.

3. Without looking into anything else, solely on the touchstone of Article 21 of the Constitution of India, we are inclined to allow this application and we hereby do suspend the sentence of imprisonment of the present applicant.

4. It is thus ORDERED that the applicant, namely, BISWAJIT MONDAL shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand), with one registered surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Nadia at Krishnagar, subject to condition that the applicant, while on bail, shall not leave the geographical limits of the district of Nadia, except for the purpose of attending Court proceedings and shall report to the Inspector-in-Charge/Officer-in-Charge, Krishnagar Kotwali Police Station, Nadia, once in a month,
until further orders and that the applicant shall be personally present or be represented through his Biswajit Mondal vs Unknown on 25 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/65754827/

5.
The operation of the order of conviction and sentence shall remain suspended till disposal of the appeal or until further orders, whichever is earlier.

6. The department is directed to forward a copy of this order to the Superintendent of the concerned Correctional Home for immediate release of the applicant/appellant unless he is wanted in connection with any other case.

7. We clarify that the observations made by us in this order are only for the purpose of disposing of the application for suspension of sentence and the same shall have no relevance at the final hearing of the appeal.

8. The application being IA No: CRAN/2/2020(Old No:
CRAN/134/2020) is accordingly disposed of.
We see that the paper book in connection with this appeal is ready.
Learned Advocates for the parties will be at liberty to collect the paper book from the department.

10. Place the appeal in the Combined Monthly list of April, 2026, before the Bench having determination.
